chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halby, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the man who emancipates the slave girl and says, 'Your dower is your emancipation,' so he said: 'It is good.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a master frees his slave girl and declares her freedom is her dowry?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the validity of 'tadbir' by stipulation, where a master emancipates his slave girl by declaring her freedom as her dower (mahr). Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) affirms this arrangement as 'hasan' (good/valid), reflecting the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the conversion of financial obligations into emancipation. This ruling underscores the principle that emancipation can be treated as a contractual settlement, facilitating the social integration of freed slaves.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about the man who emancipates the slave girl, and he is saying, ‘Your dower is your emancipation’.
